SwiftMove Relocation Services — Making moves simple since 2004

Whether you are moving across town or across the state, SwiftMove's trained crews will handle your belongings with care. We offer:
• Local moves (within 50 miles): hourly rates starting at $120 for a two-person crew and truck
• Long-distance moves: flat rates based on the weight of your shipment

Book online at www.swiftmove.com before June 30 and receive 10 percent off any local move. Customers who book packing services along with a long-distance move receive one month of free storage.

Posted July 20 by Renata Silva
Rating: ★★★☆☆

I used SwiftMove earlier this month when I relocated from Sacramento to San Diego for a new job. Because my new apartment wasn't ready yet, I took advantage of the special offer and kept my furniture in one of their units for a few weeks without paying anything. The crew that packed my belongings was fast and professional.

Unfortunately, when my furniture was delivered, I noticed that one leg of my dining table had been broken. I filed a claim online the next day, as instructed. The company responded within two days and agreed to cover the cost of a repair, which I appreciated. However, the repair has still not been arranged, and nobody has returned my calls this week. I would consider using SwiftMove again, but only if its customer service becomes more consistent.

=== PASSAGE 1: ARTICLE ===
Clearwater Farmers Market to Move to Larger Site

CLEARWATER (March 2) — After eight successful seasons in the parking lot of the Clearwater Public Library, the Clearwater Farmers Market will relocate to Lakefront Park when it reopens on May 2. The new site can accommodate up to 80 vendors, nearly double the current number, and offers shaded seating and public restrooms.

"Every year we've had to turn away growers and artisans because we simply ran out of space," said market manager Helen Ostrowski. "Lakefront Park lets us welcome them and gives shoppers a more pleasant place to spend a Saturday morning."

The market will continue to operate on Saturdays from 8:00 A.M. to 1:00 P.M. In addition, a new Wednesday evening market, featuring prepared foods and live music, will be held from 4:00 to 8:00 P.M. in July and August. Vendor applications for the season are due April 1 and are available on the market's Web site.

===
=== PASSAGE 2: FORM ===
Clearwater Farmers Market — Vendor Application

Business name: Pine Hollow Honey
Contact person: Samuel Okonjo
Phone: 555-0182

Do you require access to electricity? [ ] Yes   [X] No
Have you been a vendor at the Clearwater Farmers Market before? [ ] Yes   [X] No

Signature: Samuel Okonjo     Date: March 27

All applications must be submitted with a copy of the vendor's sales tax permit.

===
=== PASSAGE 3: E-MAIL ===
To: Samuel Okonjo <sam@pinehollowhoney.com>
From: Helen Ostrowski <manager@clearwatermarket.org>
Date: April 8
Subject: Your application

Dear Mr. Okonjo,

Thank you for applying to sell at the Clearwater Farmers Market. I am pleased to tell you that your application has been approved for the Saturday market. You have been assigned booth 47, near the park's east entrance.

Unfortunately, all spaces at our Wednesday evening market have been reserved for vendors and performers who fit the theme of that event, so we are unable to include you this year. I hope you understand.

Please note that our opening day coincides with the Clearwater Spring Festival in the park, and we expect especially large crowds. Vendors are asked to arrive by 7:00 A.M. so that setup is complete before the market opens.

Best regards,
Helen Ostrowski
